verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter is an immigration law firm selling attorney-led petition services. API-versus-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. Its client document portal does not make a programmatic API a fair comparison axis, and the probe found no OpenAPI spec, so no evidence shows the firm ships an API that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
